name: LDR Light Sensor Module
fullName: Light Dependent Resistor (Photoresistor) Module with LM393 Comparator
tagline: Ambient light intensity detector with digital threshold trigger and analog output
description: The LDR Sensor module uses a Cadmium Sulfide (CdS) photoresistor whose electrical resistance decreases with increasing incident light levels. Paired with an onboard LM393 comparator and trimmer potentiometer, it outputs both analog light level voltages and a digital light/dark switching trigger.

specs.spectralPeak: 540 nm (visible light sensitivity matching human eye)

wiringNote: Use the onboard potentiometer to set the trigger threshold for day/night switching or optical data reception.
commonMistakes: Placing module in shadowed enclosures causing false dark triggers
Confusing Active-HIGH vs Active-LOW comparator logic
